definitions.explanation: Loose, wet sand that gives way under weight and swallows what steps on it; also sand carried along by water or wind.

examples.english: My feet get caught in quicksand.

examples.japanese: {流砂|りゅうさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{流砂|りゅうさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{沈|しず}みかける⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{助|たす}けられる→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: In the film, the hero starts to sink into quicksand but is rescued by his friends.

notes:
A technical and literary word; in everyday Japanese quicksand is met mostly in adventure films and nature documentaries.
